human_checkpoints_pending.reason: Stage 7 gate failed twice. Per the loop protocol I stopped rather than attempting a third fix, because the remaining options all change something outside Stage 7's mandate.
findings: Engine over-predicts tiebreaks by 8.2pp and total games by 2.41 per match on TUNE, uniformly across favourite strength and both formats.
The spec's assumed direction (engine understates tiebreaks) does not hold on this data; the fitted correction is a deflation, not an inflation.
The close-set-only lever hit its grid edge at -0.06 and closed only 37% of the gap.
Games PIT is mislocated, not just narrow (coverage 0.731 vs 0.80), so the variance correction has nothing to fix until the location bias is addressed.
options_needing_a_decision: A: widen Stage 7's mandate to a third correction - a GLOBAL hold deflation applied at all set states, not only close ones. Directly targets the measured bias but adds a correction the spec does not name.

B: treat this as an upstream Stage 2/4 problem - the level (pa+pb) is calibrated to serve points won, which does not reproduce realized break frequency. Fixing it there cascades through Stages 4-6 and requires re-running them.
C: accept partial correction and relax the Stage 7 gate criteria. Not recommended: it would mean shipping a games model that is 2 games long on average into Stage 8 and the backtest.

stage_0.notes: REDONE on TML-Database (vendor/). 100,658 matches 2010-01-03..2023-11-27, 39,596 ATP + 61,062 Challenger; 2024-2026 files never opened. stage_1.notes: engine.py closed form + simulate.py point-level MC. 55 gate tests pass: p_hold(0.5)==0.5 exactly, p_hold monotonic over p in (0.01,0.99), p_hold and p_tiebreak (7- and 10-point) match state-expansion enumeration to 1e-12 at 6 and 8 (pa,pb) points respectively; match distribution matches 70k-match point-level MC (>=1e7 points) within 4 SE on P(A), mean total games and P(any tiebreak) for all five format variants (advantage bo5, 12-12 TB bo5, 10-pt TB bo5, 7-pt TB bo5, 7-pt TB bo3) at two (pa,pb) pairs; symmetry p_match(a,b)+p_match(b,a)==1 and mirrored joint games distribution; advantage-set truncated mass ~1e-11 < TAIL_MASS_THRESHOLD 1e-9; ladder monotone; over+under+push==1; suspect-flagged matches excluded from validation targets. No hyperparameter fitted, so no ledger entry.

stage_2.notes: Selected on TUNE: half-life 730d, surface pooling 300 serve points, shrinkage n0 500 serve points (4x4x4 grid). GATE PASSED on both required comparisons: next-match serve-points-won MAE 0.06595 vs career-average 0.06834 and last-10 0.07004; match-winner log-loss through the Stage 1 engine 0.67106 vs 0.71706 and 0.74711. n=21,244 player-matches on TUNE. FIT-internal rolling-origin gain over career average: +0.00111/+0.00107/+0.00098/+0.00102/+0.00124 (mean +0.00108, std 0.00010); TUNE gain +0.00071 - BELOW the FIT gain, so no overfit signal. Opponent adjustment converged within 50 sweeps at 1e-6 with the level-period average serve-win% as the identifiability anchor. Ledger entry frozen. NOTE: serve_stats_valid now also excludes score_string_suspect rows (ground rule 8) - found by a test, fixed, dataset rebuilt (91,242 usable rows).

stage_3.notes: Surface Elo. Selected on TUNE (144-setting grid): K=48, Challenger K x0.75, surface blend 0.3, inactivity half-life 1095d, new-player level gap 100, cross-level offset 0. GATE PASSED: decile calibration max |gap| 0.0170 and mean |gap| 0.0085 against pre-set criteria 0.05/0.025; Brier 0.22483 vs rankings-baseline 0.22993 (log-loss 0.63977 vs 0.65107) on 11,225 TUNE matches. CROSS-LEVEL CHECK reported: Challenger-built vs tour-rated, n=2,883, predicted 0.4243 vs observed 0.4131, gap -0.0112 = 1.2 SE, within noise, so no level offset fitted. FIT rolling-origin gain mean +0.00833 std 0.00268, TUNE gain +0.01130, excess 0.00297 < envelope 0.00536 - no overfit signal. Ledger frozen.

stage_4.notes: Blend of serve gap and Elo gap; level taken from Stage 2, split blended. Elo win prob converted to a serve gap by inverting the Stage 1 engine on a 26x81 (level,gap) grid, round-tripped to 0.01 in tests. GATE PASSED: per-bucket w TUNE log-loss 0.63470 vs w=0 0.67107 and w=1 0.63655 on 10,622 TUNE matches. Selected w: overall 0.80; both-well-sampled 0.80, one-thin 0.85, both-thin 0.90 (thin threshold 1000 effective serve points) - thin data wants more Elo, as the spec expected. Disagreement metadata: mean abs 11.64pp, p90 24.50pp, 47.5% of matches above 10pp; carried out per match, not absorbed. FIT rolling-origin gain mean +0.00243 std 0.00097, TUNE gain +0.00185 - below FIT gain, no overfit signal.

stage_5.notes: Cohort kNN prior replaces the flat tour-average prior for thin players. Style vector: ace rate, DF rate, serve pw, return pw, clay lean, hand, height; features AND standardization stats both as-of the 91-day snapshot (test asserts truncating the future leaves earlier snapshots bit-identical). GATE PASSED on both required metrics, TUNE thin-data matches only (n=3,199): match-winner log-loss 0.63883 vs tour-average 0.63939; total-games CRPS 3.7113 vs 3.7191. Selected k=5. The opponent-vs-cohort adjustment is implemented and measured: it improves CRPS (3.7025) but costs log-loss (0.64043), and selection is on log-loss, so it ships OFF (opponent_vs_cohort_n0=0). Grid in the report shows the trade. FIT rolling-origin gain mean +0.00120 std 0.00038, TUNE gain +0.00056 - below FIT gain, no overfit signal.

stage_6.notes: Venue court-speed index, keyed (tourney_code, surface). FIRST ATTEMPT FAILED: multipliers estimated from raw serve-points-won made TUNE total-games CRPS at above-median-history venues WORSE at every setting (baseline 3.8418; best candidate 3.8499, worst 3.8587). Diagnosis: the raw average confounds court speed with field strength - a venue whose draw is full of big servers looks fast. FIX (one attempt, per the loop protocol): estimate the venue effect as a residual, observed serve points won over the model's own expected, so the field cancels. Residual multipliers are tighter than raw (std 0.0062 vs 0.0110, correlation 0.78). GATE PASSED on re-run: CRPS at above-median-history venues 3.8404 vs baseline 3.8418; unmeasured venues unchanged at 3.5880 (they get exactly the surface average, flagged measured=False). Selected shrink_n0=20,000 serve points, indoor flag not in the key (no measurable effect). Gain is small (+0.0014 CRPS); FIT rolling-origin gain mean +0.00149 std 0.00252, TUNE gain +0.00144 - no overfit signal.

stage_7.notes: GATE FAILED TWICE - STOPPED per the loop protocol. The engine does not understate tiebreaks on this dataset, it OVERSTATES them, and it overstates total games too. TUNE (6,000 matches, pooled provenance): observed tiebreak rate 0.3445 vs predicted 0.4264, gap -0.0819; predicted total games 26.46 vs actual 24.05, bias +2.41 games; games PIT coverage 0.731 against a nominal 0.80 with PIT deviation 0.0286. The games bias is present at EVERY favourite-strength quintile and both formats (bo3 quintile means 25.05/25.35/25.30/25.05/24.49 predicted vs 23.34/23.42/23.35/22.37/22.06 actual; bo5 worse, 40.42 vs 32.56 for the strongest favourites). ATTEMPT 1: inflation grid was one-sided [0, +0.015], so it could not express a negative measured gap; every setting selected 0 and nothing changed. ATTEMPT 2 (the one allowed fix): grid extended to negatives [-0.06 .. +0.01]. The fit went straight to the grid edge, -0.06, and still closed only 37% of the gap (-0.0819 -> -0.0512). Diagnosis: a close-set-only correction is the wrong lever for a bias spread across every set state - it can only act from 5-5 onward, while the engine produces too few breaks throughout. The variance correction cannot help either, because the games distribution is MISLOCATED (+2.4 games) rather than merely narrow, so widening it does not make the PIT uniform; sigma selected 0.0 for the pooled scheme. Provenance schemes were all measured: documented-only has far fewer matches (483 of 6,000) and a worse gap (-0.1431 -> -0.1055); pooled was selected. Ledger entries written UNFROZEN. Stages 2-6 remain frozen and untouched.
